source: pre-declared rule from MathorCup_A_v6_面向复赛修改说明.md §5
edgeRule: edge {i, j} for i < j iff |rho_ij| >= threshold
signRule: sign of rho_ij is kept on the edge; the graph is undirected in topology, signed in value
nodeRule: all 231 chemistry features of data/clean/q2_chem_meta.json, in corrIndex order
thresholdSource: fixed by the v6 task list before looking at the measured counts; not tuned

alignment.rule: position (corrIndex) is used ONLY after it is verified by the corrLabel text on both axes

scope: descriptive, same-source with the attachment: Q2 network/factor interpretation only. The predictive training graph is rebuilt inside every training resample at tau = 0.5 (q2_fix.py -> q1_lib.build_graph); this full-sample table never enters the validation.
